grantedPrimeAdvantages.name: Apex Predators
grantedPrimeAdvantages.text: If a Unit that only includes Models with the Rangda Trait and the Infantry or Paragon Type is selected to fill a Prime Force Organisation Slot, the following Prime Advantage can be selected: Apex Predators. All Models in the Unit increase the value of their Fear (X) Special Rule by 1, to a maximum of Fear (3).

grantedPrimeAdvantages.name: Collared Legion
grantedPrimeAdvantages.text: If a Unit that only includes Models with the Thrall Trait is selected to fill a Prime Troops Slot, the following Prime Advantage can be selected: Collared Legion. The Unit increases the value of its Line (X) Special Rule by 1, and for the Neural Collars Special Rule it counts as being within 12" of a friendly Rangdan Model while any of its Models is within 18" of one.

grantedPrimeAdvantages.name: Collar-bombs
grantedPrimeAdvantages.text: If a Unit with the Iron Chain Trait, the Thrall Trait and the Infantry Type is selected to fill a Prime Force Organisation Slot, the following Prime Advantage can be selected: Collar-bombs. Once per battle, at the start of any Phase, if any enemy Unit is within 3" of this Unit, the Controlling Player may detonate its collars: every Model in this Unit is Removed as a Casualty, and every enemy Unit with any Model within 3" of it suffers D6 Hits at Strength 6, AP 4, Damage 1.

grantedPrimeAdvantages.name: Sated Gestalt
grantedPrimeAdvantages.text: If a Unit that only includes Models with the Slaugth Trait and the Carrion Feast Special Rule is selected to fill a Prime Force Organisation Slot, the following Prime Advantage can be selected: Sated Gestalt. Models in the Unit regain two lost Wounds, instead of one, each time the Carrion Feast Special Rule is triggered.
